title: Route Event Receipt
description: Telemetry receipt for a single route health event, tracked by vendor × model × surface × error code. Feeds the route admission registry (hummbl-admission-controlled-state#5) by making recurrence patterns visible at the model × surface granularity that vendor-level status pages hide. Motivated by the Claude elevated-error recurrence (10+ incidents Jun 2 - Jul 4 2026) where Opus 4.8 was disproportionately affected but the pattern was invisible at vendor-level status granularity, and by the Anthropic error docs distinction between 529 overloaded_error (capacity, retry with backoff) and 429 rate_limit_error (quota, do not retry aggressively).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of this event observation.

model.description: Model identifier (e.g. claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-4-8, gpt-5, gemini-3-pro). Free string — model names change frequently.

surface.description: Product surface where the event was observed.

event_class.description: incident = observed error; health_check = periodic probe; degradation = vendor-acknowledged degradation; recovery = vendor-acknowledged resolution.

status_code.description: HTTP status code (0 for non-HTTP events).

error_type.description: Error type. overloaded_error = 529 (capacity saturation); rate_limit_error = 429 (quota); api_error = 500/502/503; timeout = request timed out; silent_drop = action reported success but produced nothing (false-green).

retry_policy.description: Retry policy that should be applied for this error type. 529 → retry_with_backoff (capacity is transient); 429 → retry_once or fail_fast (don't burn quota); silent_drop → circuit_breaker_open (fundamental breakage).

failover_policy.description: Failover policy for this error type. switch_model = failover to another model from same vendor; switch_vendor = failover to another vendor; queue_and_wait = queue the request; escalate = require operator decision.

incident_ref.description: Reference to upstream incident (status page URL, incident ID). Required for degradation and recovery events.

first_seen_at.description: When this error signature (vendor × model × surface × error_type) was first observed. Required when occurrence_count > 1.

last_seen_at.description: When this error signature was last observed. Required when occurrence_count > 1.

occurrence_count.description: How many times this error signature has been observed. 1 = first observation. >1 = recurrence.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence (status page URL, log line, GitHub issue, bus receipt). Ephemeral sources must be marked.

notes.description: Additional context (e.g. 'Fable 5 relaunch contributed to load').

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt (excluding the hash field). Tamper detection.
